results.title: ‎Wispim: Voice Teleprompter App - App Store
results.content: Record videos without stumbling. The script follows your voice, even over Instagram or TikTok. Most teleprompters scroll at a fixed speed and leave you chasing the text. Wispim follows the words you say, so you can look at the lens and speak naturally. FOLLOWS YOUR VOICE The script moves as you speak, waits while you think, and can find an earlier line when you repeat it. No speed to set or guess. READS OVER YOUR CAMERA APP Put the script in a floating window and record in Camera, Instagram, TikTok or another app. Move and rotate the window to place it under the lens. RECORD IN WISPIM Record video with your script in front of you, using the front or back camera. The script follows your voice while you record, and videos are saved to Photos. ON IPHONE DUO Film yourself with the back camera [...] to Photos. ON IPHONE DUO Film yourself with the back camera and read your script on the outer display. SPEAK TO CONTROL IT Say pause, continue, go back, restart or go to the end to control the prompter. BUILT FOR REAL TAKES • In full screen, tap a word to continue from it • In Voice mode, drag to read ahead; when you speak again, Wispim follows your words • Mirror mode for a beam-splitter rig • Adjustable text size, margins, line spacing and weight • Countdown before the take starts • Import TXT, Markdown, PDF, DOCX, and RTF THIRTY-SIX LANGUAGES The app is translated into thirty-six languages. Voice following works in every language your iPhone recognises, and spoken commands work in ten of them. PRIVACY Wispim does not receive your scripts or audio. Speech recognition runs on-device [...] your scripts or audio. Speech recognition runs on-device where available; otherwise iOS may send audio to Apple to convert it to text, which Wispim never receives. You can turn off usage statistics not linked to you in Settings. FREE AND PRO Free: six prompter takes, with voice following, voice commands and the floating window. Writing and editing scripts is free and unlimited. Pro: unlimited takes, import TXT, Markdown, PDF, DOCX, and RTF, and your script library on all your iPhones, through your own iCloud.
